objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a spotted coat pattern.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length: Possesses an exceptionally long neck that is significantly longer than the legs and torso combined.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Head_Appendages: Features two to five permanent, skin-covered bony protrusions (ossicones) on the top of the head.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coat_Pattern: Displays a distinct coat pattern of irregular brown patches separated by lighter cream or white lines.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Proportions: Exhibits a sloping back profile where the hindquarters are higher than the shoulders.
